newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Spotsylvania, Va..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Spotsylvania, Va..

text.p: Water and Sewer System Revenue Bonds, Series of 1997

SEALED BIDS will be received by Wheat First Butcher Singer, Financial Advisor to the County of Spotsylvania, Virginia (the County''), on behalf of the County Board of Supervisors, until 11:00 a.m., Local Time, on
at the offices of Wheat First Butcher Singer, Riverfront Plaza, West Tower, 901 East Byrd Street, 4th Floor,
Section), for the purchase of $49,060,000 Water and Sewer System Revenue Bonds, Series of 1997 (the

described herein, at which time the bids will be publicly opened. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry system with no distribution of physical bond certificates to the public. The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form in denominations of $5,000 or any multiple thereof. The Bonds will be dated July 1, 1997, and will mature or be subject to mandatory sinking fund redemption on June 1 in each of the years 1998 to 2027, inclusive. Bonds maturing on or after June 1, 2008, will be callable on or after June 1, 2007, all as described in the County's detailed Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be limited obligations of the County payable from revenues to be derived from the County's water and sewer system. The approving opinion of Hunton &Williams, Richmond, Virginia, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the County. MBIAInsurance Corporation (MBIA'') has issued a

commitment for municipal bond insurance relating to the Bonds. All bids may be conditioned upon the issuance, effective as of the date on which the Bonds are issued, of a policy of insurance by MBIA insuring the payment when due of principal of and interest on the Bonds. Additional information, including the detailed Notice of Sale, the Official Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement, may be obtained from the Public Finance
Department, Wheat First Butcher Singer, 901 East Byrd Street, Richmond, Virginia 23219 (804-782-3373), Financial Advisor to the County.
By: L. Kimball Payne, III, County Administrator
